access_boundary: This record represents the nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16 v1.0 release dated December 15, 2025. The Base-BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 repositories, the 4B and Omni variants, downstream quantizations, the NVIDIA build.nvidia.com trial endpoint, and NIM packaging are separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: NVIDIA publishes ungated Safetensors shards with a stated model version, release date, and links to the base variant
The model card documents Transformers, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp paths and ships the reasoning parser and model code in the repository
tradeoffs: The governing license lives on an NVIDIA web page that can change independently of the pinned repository
Loading requires trusted remote code from the repository and the documented hardware list is NVIDIA-only
